remarks: Welcome to this bright and inviting two-bedroom townhouse ideally located in the desirable Heritage Hill community. This light-filled home features a spacious living room that opens to your own private terrace-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Enjoy modern comfort with new windows installed in 2020, in-unit laundry on the lower level, and 1 full and 1 half bath designed for convenience. Heritage Hill offers a tranquil setting with beautifully maintained grounds and two sparkling swimming pools for residents to enjoy during the warmer months. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, down sizing, or simply looking for easy, maintenance-free living close to downtown New Canaan's shops and restaurants, this lovely home has it all. Don't miss this opportunity to own in one of New Canaan's most desirable townhouse communities! Special plantings to the left and right of the front door are Taxus Baccata, and Irish Yew that the current owner had planted.
